text:
Halcyon Relay has leased the Brevik ground station, according to the Brevik Ground Station Lease Agreement filed with the regional port and telecommunications registry.

The document records that the lease was signed on 14 March 2031. It runs for 12 years and carries a value of 48 million euros.

Ingrid Solvang, Director of Ground Infrastructure at Halcyon Relay, confirmed the agreement when contacted about the filing. The registry entry identifies the satellite operator as the lessee of the facility.

The filing sets out the term and the total value of the arrangement. It is the principal public record of the transaction.

The Continental Record reviewed the registered agreement in preparing this report. Halcyon Relay is named in the filing as the operator holding the lease on the Brevik station for the full 12-year term.
